intended_behavior: Ensure this method sanitizes the message returned from the summarization agent by removing any toolUse blocks before marking it as a user message and returning it. This ensures that the summary message complies with AWS Bedrock API constraints, preventing ValidationException due to toolUse in user messages, while preserving the summarization content.

This method should sanitize the summary message produced by the direct model call to remove any toolUse blocks before setting the role to user and returning. This will prevent invalid user messages containing tool uses from being sent to the API, preserving existing summarization logic and output content.

Add a helper method that takes a message and removes or transforms any structured output (toolUse) content, ensuring resulting messages are valid user role messages suitable for AWS Bedrock Converse API calls. This utility can be used by both _generate_summary_with_agent and _generate_summary_with_model to apply consistent sanitization.
